integrity: The proof is self-contained; finite numerical and integer diagnostics supplement rather than substitute for the universal symbolic argument. The scientific comparison has incomplete access to some relevant full manuscripts.
scientific_limitations: Exactly complex vectors with at most two nonzero coordinates on finite even cyclic grids; two full unoversampled patterns per grid. Exact noiseless recovery only; no dimension-uniform noise stability, higher sparsity or full-signal guarantee. Historical bibliographic equivalence cannot be excluded.
title: Optimal two-mask Fourier retrieval of two-sparse signals on every even cycle
